title: Greek Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with lentils, aromatic spices, and smoky undertones. Perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lentils, aromatic spices, smoky paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Add the canned tomatoes and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
